coordinate_system: Original source pixel coordinates; origin upper-left; polygons list [x,y] vertices
status: Manually annotated anatomical ownership regions and segmentation seeds, not final pixel-accurate alpha contours
instructions: Retain original reference RGB pixels. These polygons guide ownership; do not regenerate visible artwork.
Intersect every region with a separately verified character foreground matte. A polygon alone is NOT an alpha cutout: the source has an opaque dark gradient background.
Use the segmentation aid to refine actual ink contours inside these anatomical regions. At uncertain internal boundaries preserve neutral reconstruction first, then inspect articulation.
Assign visible ownership front-to-back in ownership_priority order, subtracting already assigned pixels. Back_hair receives the remaining verified character foreground, never remaining background.
Store each cutout's original source origin. Neutral reconstruction places pixels back at that origin, with no resizing or per-part recentering.
Head region includes the visible face and crown for the identity-first neutral comparison. Later expression separation must not silently replace their visible neutral pixels.
Joint padding extends only into normally occluded regions. Preserve an explicit original-visible mask and verify its RGB is unchanged. Do not use regenerated source parts over visible concept pixels.

The far profile arm is not independently visible enough to extract honestly. Do not fabricate a second measured silhouette; hidden extension or separately approved art is required for poses exposing it.

matte_requirements.interior_rgb: exact source RGB under the original-visible mask
matte_requirements.outer_edge: Use a reviewed foreground matte; antialiased source-edge RGB already contains dark background. Alpha recovery/background unmix is not bit-identical RGB and must be separately documented.
matte_requirements.neutral_reconstruction: All assigned masks union to verified character foreground; no dropped or double-owned pixels; reconstruct at exact source coordinates before native binding.

head_face_crown.semantic_bounds: Crown, scalp, side hair around face, ears, whole face and chin; lower long tresses belong to back_hair
head_face_crown.expression_partition_rule: Refine feature masks inside these seed polygons to original ink/color pixels with antialias allowance; retain white eye interiors exactly. Neutral face layer receives those original pixels. Blank head base needs underlying skin/hair restored only where neutral feature pixels were removed. Transparent holes alone are insufficient for alternate expressions. Keep face silhouette/chin/ears/hairline in headbase, not the expression layer.

left_forearm.note: Long hanging cloth belongs to this articulated sleeve, not to the hand. Refine its boundary against skirt and back hair using the actual black outline.

skirt.note: Torso lower ornament and sleeves own their foreground pixels first; skirt is the underlying gown.

back_hair.operation: verified foreground minus all higher-priority visible ownership masks
back_hair.note: Can be split into left/right tresses after exact neutral reconstruction. Preserve each half's original source origin; do not recenter halves independently.

head_face_crown.expression_partition_rule: Profile nose is the outer head silhouette and remains in headbase. Separate eye/brow/mouth original pixels only; preserve approved white sclera. Restore underlying skin/hair in the base where those neutral features were removed, especially eyelashes crossing the bang.

back_hair.operation: verified foreground minus all higher-priority visible ownership masks

profile.not_extractable_note: These are not supplied by the approved two-angle raster as separately visible complete art; do not label them exact original cutouts.

checks: On the approved background, recomposite visible cutouts at original origins and compare RGB byte-for-byte inside the union of original-visible masks.
Display masks with labels over the ORIGINAL source and review hand-versus-sleeve, sleeve-versus-skirt, and chin-versus-collar boundaries before padding.
No point of the scythe reference or text labels belongs to either character matte.
Visible pixels must never be supplied from regenerated source sheets. Only separately masked hidden padding may use those sheets.
A successful exact neutral reconstruction does not by itself establish native shared-frame compatibility or animated joint continuity.
